text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My, so the lineup for the "Shuteisha 
Exhibition Match" has finally been 
decided!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, the selection took 
into account various factors like ability, 
track record, influence, and trends. Then, 
if I may be so bold, I will likely be 
chosen as a member—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Please, don't look at me with 
such sorrowful eyes."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I understand now. This is... an ordeal! It 
is divine revelation, bidding me to 
overcome hardship, don even greater 
brilliance, and reign supreme over the 
turf next time.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is merely a stepping stone— 
Naturally, I can accomplish it. For I am 
special.
